title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-009
doc_notes: This document is a transcript of an FAA interview with a JAL First Officer regarding a UAP sighting in 1986.

incidents.summary: JAL First Officer Takanori Tamefuji reports sighting unidentified lights while in flight over Alaska.
incidents.explanation: Military personnel suggested weather interference, which the witness disputed due to clear skies.
incidents.quote: I am certain that I saw something.
